notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a card using Lurrus this turn.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Felidar Guardian, adding {C}{C}.
When Felidar Guardian dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Dance of the Dead from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
When Dance of the Dead enters the battlefield, it returns Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield with Dance of the Dead attached to it.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Repeat.
